text: Maintaining a healthy lifestyle involves more than just eating well. A balanced diet, rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, gives your body the fuel it needs to function properly. Regular exercise, even a daily walk, strengthens your heart and boosts your mood. Equally important is getting enough sleep—aim for seven to nine hours each night—because it helps your body recover and your mind stay sharp. Don’t overlook your mental health, either; taking time to relax or talk to friends reduces stress. Finally, find a healthy work-life balance by setting boundaries and making time for hobbies. Small, consistent choices lead to lasting well-being.
